programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey picks up right where he left off a few weeks ago and proceeds to install a brand new short bed, on the chassis of a truck that was born a LONG BED. That’s right, with the cutting done, the next step is to assemble a new short bed using all new aftermarket parts. You hear people say, “if it was that easy, everybody would be doing it!” Well, it IS that easy, and a lot of people ARE doing it… and YOU need to be one of them! Now… chop to it!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It was one of the most lethal airplanes of WWII… the P-38 Lightning. Stacey takes a look at what made it so unique and why the German army nicknamed it the “Forked tailed devil”. But the legend didn’t end in the 1940’s… it continues on as Stacey showcases the new P-38 engine parts from Jon Kaase that you can put on your small block Ford to make it run like greased lightning! After that, Stacey sits down with Rock and Roll legend and certified car nut, James Burton, to dig into the unique connection between cars, guitars, and Rock and roll. Turn it on… crank it up… and hold on!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Some of the most neglected tools around the house are lawn and garden tools. Mowers, weed-eaters, chain saws, etc. all usually get thrown in a garage in the fall, never to be touched again until spring. Stacey walks through the simple steps on how to care for those tools, so they give you years of trouble free service. After that, He goes through the many parts you will need to put a manual transmission into a project, with Transmission Tech. Finally, if you’re looking for a simple project to do over the weekend, how about a muffler swap? You say “no”?... Stacey says “yes.”

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The V8 Interceptor is BACK and wearing a striking coat of glossy black paint! How did it happen? Well, Stacey walks you through the process and shows off the incredible paint and body work that was done by the Hot Rod Institute. From the subtle body nips and tucks, to the major fabrication of a new roof, this classic Cougar now has a straighter body than anything that may have rolled off the assembly line in 1967! But the paint is only half the story, as Stacey starts to re-assemble the car with bumpers, lights and engine, you start to get a good look at what is rapidly becoming the ultimate street predator!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What is cooler than a vintage tow truck? … Nothing! Stacey proves that point by rolling Heavy Metal back into the GEARZ shop to outfit it with new electric winches, and an amazing custom tool box and light bar. This ’69 International cabover truck may have been rescued from a junkyard, but it won’t be long before this truck starts pulling off rescues of its own! This is recycling at it’s best! Then ride along with Stacey and crew as they travel to Minnesota and get the story on Edwards Manufacturing and how they have managed to stay in business for over a hundred years building simple tools. It’s all good, and it’s all GEARZ!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When you say “HEMI”, you get people’s attention! But when you say “Ray Barton HEMI” you win races. Stacey and crew take you to Ray Barton Racing Engines to show you the amazing engines and parts they build, and why they go so fast. After that, Stacey digs into the interior of the V8 Interceptor and shows what kind of options you have when you are restoring or customizing the interior of your project. You’ll love the custom PRS guitar and matching wood dash and steering wheel! There is no doubt that this Cougar is the perfect blend of brutal power, and sophisticated elegance.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in SGT. ROCK to take care of steering, brakes, and the exhaust system. With a quick trip to Stainless Works for a custom set of headers and exhaust system, and with the layout of the four-wheel hydraulic steering, it won’t be long before this big military beast is rolling under its own power. After that, he takes on the seat in Heavy Metal tow truck. Just because a project may have come out of a junkyard, doesn’t mean it has to look like junk. Stacey proves that by adding a custom bomber-style seat to this already VERY unique vehicle… this episode of GEARZ is the one to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey sets out to build a nice hunting rig out of a 2012 GMC 4x4 truck. But this rig belongs to John Godwin of Duck Commander, which means the truck will be spending some serious time on the road… and off… hunting for ducks. On goes a 6” lift, 35” tall tires, and massive bumpers and winch to pull this big white beast out of any mud holes it may end up in. And since it IS such a big white beast, it is only fitting that Stacey name this project “Moby Duck”! If you’ve ever wondered if it’s possible to have a daily driver, that can also be a nice hunting, fishing, or outdoor rig. This episode of GEARZ will show you how to do it.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Super Car, Hot Rods, Go Carts
programme.desc: Stacey rolls the SL-C back into the shop to show off the twin turbo system Schwartz Performance installed. If you thought 1000hp out of an LS-7 was impossible, THINK AGAIN! Even wilder is the fact that this engine is pulling that kind of horsepower on pump gas! If supercars and twin turbos are your thing, you have to see this! After that, Stacey goes through some of the problem areas that you will face when you are building a vehicle and how to pick the right project. Finally He digs into the 1st motorized vehicle that most of us had…the Go-Kart. There's something for everybody in this show. That’s why they call it GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We dig into the ultimate how-to project… building a shop! It’s an incredible transformation as Stacey and Crew take a huge open warehouse and build it into the new GEARZ shop. Along the way you’ll pick up all kinds of tips and tricks that Stacey uses when he’s setting up a useable work space. With today’s economy, there are more and more people thinking about opening a shop, or converting their existing garage space into a more useable area. This show can help you do that. After that, Stacey shows how to stop rust dead in its tracks by using the simplest tool in the box… a paint brush! It’s all here on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey makes a house call… to Pennsylvania! Why?... to pick up an old fire truck to use as a project truck to make even more house calls with! If this sounds confusing, then you NEED to see this show, because Stacey shows you how to take a vehicle that nobody really has a use for anymore, and convert it into something you can use for your home or business. Sound deadening, tool boxes, and an on-board air system are all things that you’ll see go on as the big green fire truck, begins the conversion into a rolling tool truck

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s anniversary time…the 100th episode of GEARZ! And we have put together a one-hour special of the history and making of GEARZ, in two episodes! Stacey takes a look back at how the show came about. Then he digs into some of the project vehicles, and looks at the ideas and reasoning that shaped these trend-setting vehicles. If you’re new to GEARZ or wondered how the show was put together, this episode will shed some light on that

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Part two of the 100th Episode special starts with a bang and a lot of tire smoke, as Stacey looks back at some of the wild test drives and feature vehicles that have been on GEARZ over the years. After that, they go behind the scenes and show you some of the funny and potentially dangerous situations that can happen when you work on a show like GEARZ. Finally, we showcase some of the incredible guests that have been on the show, to give you an idea of what to expect in the future. It’s all here and only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in the big green fire truck, with every intention of changing the color and look. But he’s not using paint… he’s using a vinyl wrap! If you’ve ever wondered what the deal is with vinyl wraps and if it is a good thing to do to your project, you need to see this show! But that’s not all, as the wrap is going on, Stacey also takes the time to show how to restore and bring back to life your accessories and trim without spending a lot of money.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you’ve been around cars very much, you’ve heard the term “barn find”. It depicts that “diamond in the rough” vehicle that everybody wants to find. Stacey delves into the barn find phenomenon and unveils what could be the ultimate barn find… the lost Richard Petty Car! Follow the incredible story of the car that Richard and Maurice Petty built in their early days, that was then sold and disappeared for decades... only to be found by Stacey and returned to Richard Petty so it could take its rightful place in the Petty Museum. It’s gearhead archeology at its best, and you’ll only see it on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey hits the road to visit a GEARZNation member to see if he can lend a hand on his project. The owner is a 16-year-old kid and the subject is his ’96 Dodge pickup that’s looking a little rough from years of use and abuse. That quickly changes as Stacey jumps in to help give the truck a new face, and at the same time offers tips and tricks to breathe a breath of fresh air into the project. See what a difference some time, expertise, and a few parts can make on a beat up old truck! After that, Stacey takes a look at the amazing Moduline Cabinets, and digs into what makes them so great.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey shows you how to tackle the one restoration project that everybody dreams of doing one day... the frame off restoration! You’ll be surprised how simple a job like this can be if you follow his simple tips and tricks and plan the project out properly. In the world of high dollar builds, a simple frame off restoration can get you back on the road enjoying your car or truck and at a fraction of the price. But to get a grasp on how to do it, you have to see this show. After that, Stacey swaps some licks with recording artist Casey James who just happens to be a gearhead at heart… all here… all Gearz!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: So, you think you want some custom bumpers for your big ol’ truck? Stacey shows you how to find what you’re looking for in the aftermarket, and also how to fabricate and build your own custom mounts to make ‘em sit exactly where you want them. After that he digs into the history of the Sgt. Rock truck and how it is permanently connected to “the greatest generation”. But this truck isn’t just about WWII, as a special tailgate airbrushed by Mickey Harris reveals, It’s about the men and women that have sacrificed for the freedoms we enjoy today. This is one show that will have you waving the flag!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey hits the road to help out a Gearz Nation member with his ‘56 Corvette project. Since the guy really wants to drive the car, putting in a modern 5 or 6spd tranny would be really nice. But which one? Well, we not only answer that question, but also give the guy a little helping hand with the transmission too. If you’ve ever wished Stacey made house calls, this is the show to see. After that we take a look at some serious questions that people ask about becoming a tool dealer and if it’s really worth it. You wanted to know… we got the answers for you!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey dives into the world of the sleeper, by taking a non-descript ’73 Plymouth Satellite, and begins transforming it into a street pounding monster under the skin. Gone is the lethargic 318 engine and front suspension, and in its place Stacey begins fitting a new state of the art performance suspension. It you are into surprising people at stop lights and run-what-you-brung race nights, then a “Street Sweeper” just might be the sort of approach you want to take on your next project.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Street Sweeper is back! Stacey delves into just how many parts it takes to completely change the drivetrain and suspension on a classic muscle car. Accessories, transmission, overdrive, headers, the list may seem to go on forever, but it’s all about finding the right parts in the aftermarket, to build the car that YOU want. After that it’s off to the races to see if E3’s new top fuel spark plug can handle the pressure of competition. If you want to see the ins and outs of building a car, GEARZ is the show to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you could only do one upgrade on your vehicle, that would make the biggest impact on the looks and drivability, what would it be? Stacey answers that question by installing a Katzkin leather interior into a Jeep Compass, and showing that if you’ve got an open weekend and a few hundred bucks, you can do the same thing on your car or truck. After that, he jumps back onto the Street Sweeper project to lay out the interior and the rearend, and finally drop that huge Hemi into place. If you’ve ever thought it would be fun to build a sleeper car, this is one ’73 Plymouth Satellite that shows how it can be done!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey Preps the bed of the NAPA Perfect additions truck. From rolling out Herculiner to installing transfer tank, truck boxes, and even a combination generator/compressor, this big Ford begins its Perfect Additions transformation. He also throws in a wiring tech that will keep you from getting your wires crossed.

programme.desc: Oga's family is seriously worried about Baby Beel's night crying, as it's causing everyone in the entire town to lose sleep. They try all kinds of things but nothing works. programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. - He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. - Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. - Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. - What happens when these two meet?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. - Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami escaped from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree. With nowhere to go, Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities with Ando's help. After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. - One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

With intricate use of sustainable materials, the property is showered in tranquil light with nature is weaved throughout. Just outside of Copenhagen, a sun-soaked property is made up of endless windows, delicately decorated with stylish Scandi minimalism. Arriving by kayak, Alan’s final destination is a seemingly floating villa, curved around the edges and designed for ultimate tranquil relaxation

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E01 - Russia - Comrades And Capitals
programme.desc: Anything is possible in Russia. Scott and Justin meet up with their friend Bogdan and visit the last man living in the radioactive zone in Chernobyl. They visit St. Petersburg for some homemade vodka and to celebrate Bogdan’s birthday, before hopping on an overnight train to Moscow. The adventures in Moscow are diverse: An awkward visit to a Russian bath, a wild night out in an exhilarating dance club and a chance to drive a cold-war military tank. Next, they fly to Siberia and meet a vodka-slamming shaman, who puts them all to shame on the dance floor.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E02 - Russia - The Bull Of Winter
programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: Marie Louise and the Duchy of Parma
programme.desc: In 1545, Pope Paul III took Parma and Piacenza away from the papal territories to create a new duchy for his son Pier Luigi Farnese and free them from the influence of the Lombard Gonzaga family. The first duke and his heirs Alessandro and Ranuccio welcomed some Correggio's to work in the baptistery of the cathedral and some Parmigianino's paintings in the monastery of San Paolo.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: In this episode Phillip joins American Executive Chef David Almany of Osteria Mozza, the creation of Michelin star celebrity chef Mario Batali, Joe Bastianich and Nancy Silverton and their first foray into the Singapore food scene outside the Los Angeles flagship restaurant of the same name.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Expedia Presents
programme.desc: Four Corners, in partnership with the Dominican Republic, takes viewers on an immersive journey through the vibrant culture, history, and adventure of the Dominican Republic alongside travel ambassadors Renee Hahnel, Achieng Agutu, Emily Sanchez, and Matthew Hahnel as they explore Santo Domingo, Jarabacoa, Samaná, and Puerto Plata.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We begin our trip in Arizona, the sixth largest state in the U.S.A., there we will get as close as possible to space while visiting the Pima Air & Space Museum. We will also visit the Petrified Forest National Park and the incredible Grand Canyon. To top it off we will see the beauties offered by the Navajo Nation. Then we will cross the ocean to the happiest place on earth: Norway! To enjoy this beautiful countryside landscape and visit Preikestolen, a city full of smiling people. We will go to Otter Island, one of the newest and most adorable attractions in this country. And we will discover the Botanical Gardens of Oslo and the ports of Norway where we will delight with its delicious gastronomy. To finish our trip in Australia, specifically at Shell Beach. There is a lot to do in this place, like taking a walk to the shore of a beautiful beach covered with millions of shells and finally, we will feed the dolphins in Monkey Mia, a refuge where bottlenose dolphins have made their home during the last 50 years.

programme.desc: Ariel tries kitesurfing at the Columbia River Gorge and tests her skills on a tree-to-tree ropes course outside of Portland.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel takes viewers on an insider’s tour of one of the largest, most chaotic, misunderstood and intriguing cities in the world, Mexico City. From ancient Aztec culture to the wonders of the huge El Chopo Market and Mexico City's underground culture and Lucha Libre, get ready to see Mexico City, unmasked!

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Lack of infrastructure be damned, Nicaragua has put its civil war and troubled past behind and is welcoming travelers to experience it’s countless and undiscovered natural wonders. Join the crew as we make our way from earthquake ravaged Managua to the beautiful outposts of León, Granada, Estelí & Lake Omotepe and see why Nicaragua is the hottest up and coming destination in Central America.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Mexico’s Caribbean coast is a haven for raw travelers and traditional tourists alike. From swanky resorts with pulsating nightlife to bare bones eco-touristic getaways, isolated jungles and ancient ruins, the Yucatan is a natural wonder full of contrasts. See the Yucatan, Cancun & Playa del Carmen like you’ve never seen them before.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: For decades Costa Rica has been luring surfers and eco-travelers to experience its killer waves on the coasts and its unique bio-diversity in the rain forest. We find out why travelers, from first timers to hard core veterans, consistently rave about Costa Rica, Latin America’s undisputed eco-tourism champion. There will be zip-lining (of course!), wild crocodile feeding, bat cave touring, snake handling and a whole lot more!

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: After a decades-long, brutal guerrilla war, Guatemala is waking up and rediscovering its roots as the centuries old cradle of the Mayan civilization. This small but populous country promises an authentic cultural experience unlike any other. We’ll hit an underground punk & rock show in Guate (Guatemala City) then off to some incredible landscapes and authentic indigenous cultures. Come see why we LOVE Guatemala!

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: So much more than the famous canal and modern skyline, Panama’s natural wonders shine for those willing to take the road less traveled. We explore beyond the obvious tourist sites and dig deep to uncover Panama City’s siren song that has enticed travelers for decades. The crew visits Bocas del Toro, the lovely Portobelo and then an unforgettable journey to visit the indigenous nation of the Kuna Yala at San Blas.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: No habla Espanol? No problem. A mecca for hard-core scuba divers and laid-back beach types for years, this tiny Central American country on the Caribbean coast has more to offer than at first glance, including ancient ruins, a melting pot of cultures and a wealth of natural splendor. And oh yeah, they speak English.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: There is a lot to love about the laid back destination of Honduras. Raw Travel explores the little known Garifuna culture and some of Central America’s best beaches and coral reefs for one of the most incredible and economical scuba destinations around.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: New York City: Big Apple for Beginners
programme.desc: Throw out the tourist map, Raw Travel is taking a fresh look at the Big Apple like never before. The crew takes viewers on a virtual trip to some of the best, hidden secrets NYC has to offer. Raw Travel delves deep into this amazing city’s diverse “off the beaten path” neighborhoods & boroughs showcasing a virtual melting pot of cultures and influences from all over the world.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: For some travelers, the rush of travel is enough but others need more. Raw Travel invites viewers to sample the growing eco & adventure travel movement with “Raw Adrenaline”.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Nothing can add more dimension and depth to traveling than giving back. Whether it’s helping to preserve the environment, working with animals or those less fortunate, Raw Travel explores why “Voluntourism” is becoming so popular.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The Imperial Free City of Trieste
programme.desc: Threatened by the pressing Venetian advance, in 1382 Trieste submitted to the Habsburgs and hosted the Imperial Captain in the Girolamo Decio-designed fortress. In 1719 it was granted the status of free port by Charles IV of Habsburg: not only the Austrian railway connected the city to Vienna, but it was also the first docking area and international trade hub of the Empire.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 54: Ricardo y Gabriela: Amor Prohibido
programme.desc: Marisela conversa con Abril al revelarle a su amiga el motivo de su preocupaci n al saber a Ricardo y a Gabriela vinculados en una prohibida relaci n amorosa. Alfonso se muestra decidido a rehacer su vida teniendo como objetivo principal para llegar a formar una familia a Marisela y poder as redimir sus pecados al lado de la dulce muchacha. Ra l y Arelys disfrutan de la tranquilidad de su hogar tras haber logrado expulsar a Pantoja de sus vidas. Ricardo sinti ndose desesperado ante la posibilidad de llegar a perder a Gabriela por causa de sus m ltiples mentiras hace un compromiso de amor con la muchacha. en un bar cualquiera de la ciudad, Moncho se deja entusiasmar debido a la llegada de Im n al lugar,

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 97: R mulo herido, un amor imposible.
programme.desc: R mulo sigue esperando a Egle al frente de su casa, y est sumamente enojado. Pero lo que no sabe R mulo es que Egle est ya en su casa, en su cuarto preparada para acostarse y disfrutar de un buen libro mientras espera a Santiago. Mientras tanto Santiago se despide para irse a los brazos de Egle pero los all presente no lo quieren dejar ir de la fiesta, lo tratan de convencer pero sin ning n resultado, porque Santiago no se perder a por nada del mundo estar con su amada Egle. Cuando Santiago llega cerca de la casa de Egle se da cuenta que en las afueras est R mulo esperando y decide irse de all para evitarle problemas a Egle y a Lu s Fernando porque lo m s seguro es que termine cay ndose a golpe con R mulo. Gerson y Yuraima mientras bailan ven como Aureliano trata de conquistar a Dileidi. Aureliano sigue insistiendo y ella le dice que puede que ella se este enamorando de el de repente, Aureliano no le cree y la quiere besar pero en ese momento Dileidi se imagina a Lu s Fernando dici ndole algunas cosas y no puede besarlo. Mientras que en la fiesta que se esta celebrando en casa de Pascuita Felicita, Cristinita y Tatianita le pregunta a Aristigueta si es posible que un hombre aunque este con una mujer pueda querer a otra mujer a lo que Aristigueta lo confirma. Lu s Fernando que esta muy rom ntico con Mar a Gracia trata de besarla pero se imagina a Dileidi dici ndole que el en realidad lo que esta es enamorado de ella. Luego de eso Dileidi le cuenta a Yeniluz lo que paso y le confiesa que por m s que trata no puede besar a Aureliano. En casa de Gonzalo, Matilde trata de consolar a Ernesto por que su pap no fue a buscarlo y Doroteo invita a los que est n en la fiesta para armar ah mismo un grupo de m sica y cantar en vivo, pero Gonzalo propone mejor ir a casa de Monchito para estar todos completo, pero entre La Nena y Matilde los convencen para que mejor se queden all en casa de Gonzalo. En casa de Pascuita est Aristigueta queriendo ir a casa de Gonzalo para darle el feliz a o a la Nena, pero Tatianita se lo impide a toda costa junto a Pascuita. En eso llega La Nena y le reclama a Aristigueta su presencia all y lo invita a irse de inmediato de all saliendo de all la Nena para casa de Gonzalo. Mientras ella sale entra Santiago y todos lo reciben porque volvi . Betzaida esta muy preocupada porque R mulo no llega y Nancy su madre trata de consolarla. Santiago llama a Egle y le cuenta que no puede ir porque R mulo esta en la puerta de su casa. Egle no lo cree y se enfurece mucho y queda con Santiago en escaparse al d a siguiente. R mulo se da cuenta de que Egle si est en la casa y decide treparse por la reja de la casa. En ese momento Egle sale con dos tazas de caf y no lo consigue junto a su moto y se sorprende mucho al verlo encaramado en la reja y le grita su nombre, cay ndose al suelo y maltrat ndose un tobillo. Santiago en su casa le cuenta a su Abuelo todo lo que el hizo para no tener ning n altercado con R mulo y este le responde que ese fue un acto noble. Egle lleva a R mulo a una cl nica mientras el protesta y dice no tener nada, pero al revisarlo el doctor este decide tomarle radiograf as mientras Egle se ocupa de todos los tr mites, siempre dejando claro que ella no es la esposa de R mulo. Betzaida sigue muy preocupada porque no llega R mulo y su madre se preocupa tambi n. Gonzalo les dice a sus invitados que el hielo se acabo y que ahora si se tienen que ir a casa de Monchito. La Nena convence en forma amorosa a Doroteo para no ir all y le insin a que ella lo que quiere es estar a solas con el. En casa de La Nena, Tatianita le reclama a su padre todo lo que paso por culpa de el y este le pide perd n y se va al ba o. En ese momento llega La Nena con Doroteo y le inventa excusa para no quedarse all . Ya en casa de Monchito los que llegaron son recibidos con abrazos de Feliz a o y Matilde y Monchito se abrazan, pero son observados por Pascuita y Gonzalo. En casa de Gladis ella se encuentra muy animadamente hablando con Remedios, Gabito se preocupa porque piensa que pueden llegar a las manos y decide llevarse a Remedio. Aureliano sigue con la declaraci n de amor a Dileidi y le pide que le demuestre que ella est enamorada de el y le pide que la besa, pero Dileidi no puede. Aureliano se da cuenta y dice que el no puede estar con alguien que piense demasiado para besarlo. Lu s Fernando que est con Mar a Gracia lo nico que hace es hablar de Dileidi y Mar a Gracia se molesta. La Nena logra despedir a Doroteo en el ascensor con la promesa de verse al d a siguiente y aliviada porque Aristigueta y Doroteo no se encontraron pero lo que no sabe que cuando Doroteo esta en el ascensor se abren sus puertas en un piso y entra Aristigueta, salud ndose muy efusivamente y pregunt ndose que hacen all .

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 42: In s y la fortuna de Don Carlos
programme.desc: In s descubre en unos documentos que es la hija de Don Carlos Nu ez, no lo puede creer. Robert continua molesto por la actitud de su padre con In s por que ella no posee fortuna, ni apellido de renombre para ser su esposa. Martha le aclara a In s que Don Carlos no era su padre pero si era muy amigo de su padre y que este le dejo toda su fortuna a cargo para que luego se las entregaran. Reinaldo averigua cuales son las intenciones de Aldo para con su hermana Vicky. Martha le dice a In s que haga exigir sus derechos pero In s le pide que por favor calle, que ya llegar la hora de decirlo. Vicky entra en una crisis nerviosa y es hospitalizada en una cl nica.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: En la vida de Inmaculada y de Abril aparece un hombre que al parecer les hizo mucho da o en el pasado. Ellas reciben constantes amenazas por parte de este hombre llamado Salom n. Sin embargo, no pueden denunciarlo con la polic a porque todos se enterar an de un secreto que llevan bien guardado. Sof a le cuenta a Ivana que la mujer con la que Vespasiano tuvo un hijo es la Pelusa. Esto provoca un odio y una rabia enorme en la se ora. Cuando va a enfrentarse con Ruth, ella le niega todo. Igualmente, Ivana est dispuesta a hacer todo por saber la verdad sobre ese hijo. Mientras tanto, en la UDH siguen investigando en el caso de la viuda negra. Ahora apareci un nuevo hombre llamado Dennis. Para muchos l es el asesino; para otros, un c mplice de la viuda negra.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 54: Josefina trama venganza, B rbara persigue a Ramiro.
programme.desc: Socorro acepta la propuesta que le hace Salvador sobre pasar la vida juntos, aunque ambos reconocen que primero tienen que solucionar sus asuntos personales y eso tardar un buen tiempo. Josefina por su lado est tramando con Gonzalo la forma de da arle su relaci n a Salvador, ya que piensa vengarse de su falta de amor hacia ella, y para hacerlo pretende subirlo a la web y mantenerlo ocupado para que no pueda gozar de ning n minuto libre con su amada.Mientras Ramiro le confiesa a B rbara lo maravillosa que es ella para l, vemos c mo Manuel est destrozado y le llora a Pedro porque est seguro que B rbara no descansar hasta casarse con Ramiro lvarez Castillo.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland: Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal: Portuguese cuisine holds a dear place in Tony's culinary heart. Tony travels to Porto, home of the famous Port wine, where he is immediately exposed to the codfish and the almost mythical place it holds in Portuguese cuisine and culture.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Oaxaca, Mexico: Chef Tony Bourdain explores the exotic and colorful indigenous zone of Mexico's Oaxaca region where he tastes toasted grasshoppers and other delicacies. His adventure ends with mariachi music and, of course, lots of tequila.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France: Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony returns to his beloved Hanoi, Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday of Tet. Together they enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: So Much Vodka, So Little Time
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia: Tony continues his mission with a tour of local working-class specialties. He tries his hand at ice-fishing, drinks a lot of vodka, feasts on Russian foods, eats smoked fish and ends the outing with a dip in the outdoor cold pool.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: A spontaneous layover in Bangkok, Thailand leads Tony into the city, where he tries dishes of deep-fried frog skins and pla rah, a fish-paste that has fermented anywhere from three months to a year.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Which style of BBQ reigns supreme - Kansas City, Houston, or North Carolina? Tony journeys to all three cities to taste for himself the secrets behind sauces, wood pits, and slow smokers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: London, England: In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes, and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Anthony travels to Tokyo, where he begins in the Tsujiki market and then is introduced to techniques in preparing edomae sushi. He also learns the diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Everything tastes better when cooked over a fire, at least that is the Oaxacan credo. From soup to barbacoa, fiery embers influence the flavor of Oaxaca's food in just the right ways. Join Rick in Oaxaca, San Felipe Usila, and Zaachilla.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: Off the Beaten Path in Huatulco
programme.desc: Mexico's beaches glimmer with pristine perfection. Chef Rick Bayless takes us off the beaten path to find great food and even better beaches such as Playa Chahue and Playa Principal. You would be well-advised to follow his lead.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Mescal is experiencing a renaissance in Mexico and throughout the United States. Journey with Rick to witness firsthand how an Oaxacan distiller handcrafts this fine spirit renowned for its rich, smoky complexity and brightness.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Phil eagerly awaits his chance to enjoy, and learn the secrets behind, the divine cuisine found inside DC Restaurant by Darren Chin, a Chef whose inspiration is derived from the high level of satisfaction his guests continually experience.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.sub-title: New Caledonia - The Red Island with a Green Heart
programme.desc: In contrast to its neighboring islands, which are volcanic, New Caledonia is a fragment of the former continent of Zealandia that broke away some 250 million years ago. Its flora and fauna are totally unique and have evolved in a vacuum. Discover New Caledonia's marvels in a personal way.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.desc: Connecting the continents of Asia and Africa, the mountainous country of Oman is beset by sand and water. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: ¡Todos abordo por Amor!
programme.desc: Alison Marlowe tiene su vida planeada. Está cerrando la venta de la marina de su familia. Está tripulando un yate de 60 metros a través del Atlántico y comenzando su nueva y emocionante vida en lugares exóticos. Joel Cartwright, un hombre de negocios inteligente que se está tomando un descanso de la multinacional de su familia, quien quiere poner su viejo barco en el agua. Alison y Joel sienten una chispa instantánea, pero sus sentimientos pasan a un segundo plano mientras sus planes de vida la alejan de la ciudad.

programme.title: En Busca Del Amor
programme.desc: Cuando un canal de televisión anuncia que su programa de terapia psicológica será cambiado por un show de escándalos públicos, una bondadosa psicóloga firme en sus convicciones regresa a su pueblo y se reúne con el amor de su juventud. Eventualmente, se da cuenta de que tener a alguien con quien compartir la vida es más importante que la fama o la emoción de la ciudad.

programme.title: El Amor Y La Estrella de Radio
programme.desc: Savannah es contratada para renovar la imagen del presentador del programa de radio número 4 de Nueva York. programme.title: El Amor Perfecto

programme.desc: Julie Walters, estudiante de doctorado en lingüística, habla casi todos los idiomas imaginables. Es una gran creyente de que los idiomas se aprenden mejor haciendo actividades divertidas. Las cosas se ponen patas arriba para Julie cuando un empleado de un museo se pone en contacto con ella para que le dé clases de francés.

programme.title: Sobreviviendo Al Amor
programme.desc: Jessica Miller tiene que enfrentar el ‘mundo real’ después de graduarse de la universidad. Para conquistar ese mundo nuevo, ella debe descubrir su fe, abrir una caja de memorias y aprender los secretos simples de la vida que sólo una madre puede compartir.

programme.title: ¡Todos abordo por Amor!
programme.desc: Alison Marlowe tiene su vida planeada. Está cerrando la venta de la marina de su familia. Está tripulando un yate de 60 metros a través del Atlántico y comenzando su nueva y emocionante vida en lugares exóticos. Joel Cartwright, un hombre de negocios inteligente que se está tomando un descanso de la multinacional de su familia, quien quiere poner su viejo barco en el agua. Alison y Joel sienten una chispa instantánea, pero sus sentimientos pasan a un segundo plano mientras sus planes de vida la alejan de la ciudad.

programme.title: En Busca Del Amor
programme.desc: Cuando un canal de televisión anuncia que su programa de terapia psicológica será cambiado por un show de escándalos públicos, una bondadosa psicóloga firme en sus convicciones regresa a su pueblo y se reúne con el amor de su juventud. Eventualmente, se da cuenta de que tener a alguien con quien compartir la vida es más importante que la fama o la emoción de la ciudad.

programme.title: El Amor Y La Estrella de Radio
programme.desc: Savannah es contratada para renovar la imagen del presentador del programa de radio número 4 de Nueva York. Pero cuando accidentalmente termina en el aire con el anfitrión, ella misma se convierte en parte del cambio de marca del programa y descubre si las diferencias en el aire o el amor tendrán la última palabra.

programme.title: El Amor Perfecto
programme.desc: La casamentera Leah Price es la propietaria del sitio web de citas OneMatch. Pero cuando una de sus clientes sigue sin encontrar el amor, Leah acepta que el casamentero Peter Beckett la ayude. Lo que no esperaban: una pareja perfecta para ellos.

programme.title: La Bella y el Billonario
programme.desc: Jess enfrenta el escrutinio de Gordon y se cansa de que otros la pasen por encima. Mason recurre a Curt en busca de consejo sobre su padre, justo cuando su relación con él llega a un nuevo punto crítico. Un empleado descontento revela la vulnerabilidad de Mason y el peligro en el que la propia Jess se encuentra.

programme.title: 3 Citas Para Siempre
programme.desc: Maddie Mckenzie es una presentadora muy trabajadora cuyo empuje y talento la han convertido en una popular locutora de radio. John Reed es un despreocupado empresario tecnológico más interesado en organizar fiestas. Los dos no podrían ser más diferentes.

programme.title: Gloriosos camaradas
programme.desc: ¿Qué podría ser peor para dos oficiales de caballería que luchar contra las tribus nativas? Luchar entre sí por la misma mujer.

programme.title: El clan de los ahorcados
programme.desc: Un pistolero forma una banda de "muertos" víctimas de ejecución para vengarse del político y forajido que mató a su esposa.

programme.title: Hacha de guerra
programme.desc: En el New York de 1700, un artista de Boston que trabajaba en el remoto Fort Alden se ve desgarrado entre su amor por 2 mujeres y es arrojado en medio de una guerra Mohawk-Iroquois-Americana.

programme.title: Minnesota Clay Spanish
programme.desc: Minnesota Clay - Encarcelado injustamente por un crimen que no cometió, Minnesota Clay busca vengarse del hombre que retuvo pruebas en su juicio. El problema: se está quedando ciego.

programme.title: Arizona vuelve
programme.desc: El famoso pistolero Arizona Colt es enviado por Moreno para rescatar a su hija de las garras del viejo enemigo de Arizona, Keane.

programme.title: Pasión salvaje
programme.desc: Pasión Salvaje - Tras ser testigo de la masacre de la gente de su aldea, un joven Indio decide tomar venganza.

programme.desc: El maquinista de La General - Cuando los espías de la Unión roban la querida locomotora de un ingeniero, éste la persigue sin ayuda y directamente a través de las líneas enemigas.

programme.desc: El pistolero Silver es contratado por un abogado para demostrar que su cliente, Chester Conway, es inocente del atraco a la taberna por el que ha sido condenado a la horca.

programme.title: Los Profesionales del Oro
programme.desc: Cuatro hombres se embarcan en una misión para desenterrar una fortuna en oro de una mina.

programme.title: 20.000 dólares por un cadáver
programme.desc: Una pareja de granjeros lucha por sus tierras frente a un desconocido decidido a sabotear la construcción de un ferrocarril. Su tranquila vida se ve amenazada por intrigas y peligros que podrían arruinar su futuro.

programme.title: El ángel y el pistolero
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, un malvado en toda regla, es atendido y buscado por Penelope Worth, una chica cuáquera. Al final se ve obligado a elegir entre su mundo y el de Penelope.

programme.title: Una tumba para el Sheriff
programme.desc: El icono del Spaghetti Western, Anthony Steffen, protagoniza el papel de Shenandoah, un hombre misterioso que se une a una despiadada banda de salteadores de caminos tras superar una iniciación casi imposible y que desafía a la muerte.

programme.title: Ciccio perdona... ¡Yo no!
programme.desc: Los ladrones de caballos Franco y Ciccio roban sin saberlo un carruaje de oro del temido bandido «El Diablo». Perseguidos, acaban convertidos en héroes en el pueblo de Desolación, mientras el astuto forajido planea recuperar su tesoro. Por suerte, dos pistoleras con gran puntería están dispuestas a ayudar al torpe dúo en esta caótica aventura.

programme.title: Johnny Yuma
programme.desc: Johnny Yuma - Una intrigante esposa manda asesinar a su marido y también planea matar a su sobrino, el único heredero, con la ayuda de su ex amante. Cuando intenta traicionar al ex amante, éste y el heredero se alían y matan a sus guardaespaldas.

programme.title: Apache Kid
programme.desc: Unos forajidos atacan a una banda de colonos y matan a todos menos a una mujer embarazada que es rescatada por una banda de indios. La mujer muere al dar a luz, pero el jefe Oso Blanco adopta a su hijo varón, lo llama "Cielo Luminoso" y lo cría como hermano de su propio hijo, Lobo Negro.

programme.title: Dos veces Judas

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Sasha e Iván son felices, sin sospechar que han atraído la atención de Kim Olegovich, un mayor de la KGB y supervisor de la Casa de Modelos. Su objetivo es separarlos. Kim, sintiendo una atracción personal por Sasha, utiliza el chantaje y la manipulación para acercarse a ella. La relación entre Sasha e Iván comienza a desmoronarse ante sus ojos. Kim está a punto de lograr su propósito, pero entonces recibe una noticia inesperada: Sasha se va a casar. La noticia sacude no solo a Kim, sino también a toda la Casa de Modelos.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: La vida de Sasha con un esposo al que no ama se vuelve insoportable. Pero en su camino hacia la felicidad con Iván aún se interpone Kim Olegovich. Atrapados y sin salida, los amantes toman una decisión desesperada…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Lo que empieza como un cuento de hadas no siempre tiene un final feliz en la vida. La realidad es tal que a menudo el cuento de hadas de la vida termina con un final dramático. Los hechos tienen lugar en 1978. Una ingenua huérfana criada en un internado de provincias llega a la bulliciosa y concurrida capital. Sasha ya ha cumplido 18 años y necesita empezar una vida adulta e independiente. Una chica consigue un trabajo en la Casa de la Moda como limpiadora. Es aquí donde tiene que pasar de ser un felpudo discreto a un modelo famoso. Con el tiempo llegan a su vida hombres que le prestan todo tipo de atención. Tres hombres comienzan a cortejarla, todos ellos tratando de conquistar el corazón de Sasha: un artista de vanguardia llamado Iván, un vendedor ambulante llamado Vadim, que se ha criado en una familia muy respetable de la capital, y un mayor del KGB llamado Kim. ¡Pero Sasha ya ha elegido al hombre de sus sueños y para estar junto a él tendrá que pasar por un número increíble de pruebas!

programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia terminan sus estudios y tienen una vida adulta e independiente por delante. Los jóvenes se aman desde hace tiempo y con devoción y ya piensan en formar una familia. Un día, el padre de Ksenia, que trabaja como jefe de una empresa de construcción, se mete en problemas. Es sospechoso de blanqueo de dinero a gran escala y en un futuro próximo no sólo se arriesga a perder todo su patrimonio, sino también a ir a la cárcel durante mucho tiempo. De repente, un viejo conocido de la madre de Ksenia, Grigory Dmitrievich, que ocupa un alto cargo en la administración local de la ciudad, se ofrece a resolver los problemas de su padre. Sin embargo, pone una única condición a cambio: Ksenia debe casarse con su hijo Dima, un futuro pintor que estudia pintura en un colegio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Han pasado veinte años. Una familia de un renombrado artista llega a la ciudad costera para pasar el verano. Se trata de Dmitri, Ksenia y su hija Rita. Pronto, Ksenia recibe una invitación para una reunión de excompañeros de escuela y decide asistir. En el fondo, no puede negar su deseo de volver a ver a Piotr. Mientras tanto, su hija Rita, de 19 años, se ve envuelta en una situación peligrosa, de la que es rescatada por Piotr. Ahora él es un hombre respetado en la ciudad: periodista, empresario y editor de un importante periódico local. En sus manos tiene una historia explosiva sobre corrupción con antiguas casas de campo estatales del partido, propiedades de gran valor. Entre Rita y Piotr comienza a surgir una atracción.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de su hija, pero él se mantiene firme: una vez dejó ir a su gran amor y no piensa cometer el mismo error de nuevo. Está decidido a luchar por Rita. Ksenia escucha lo mismo de su hija: ella no piensa renunciar a Piotr por la opinión de sus padres. Mientras tanto, el escándalo de las casas estatales sigue creciendo. Un colega de Piotr, Edik, descubre que su teléfono está siendo intervenido. La persona detrás de esto pertenece a la élite política. Pronto, dos desconocidos irrumpen en la oficina del periódico exigiendo que entreguen el expediente comprometedor, o la familia de Piotr estará en peligro.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Piotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres por seguridad. Ksenia acepta una tregua temporal con él. Piotr entrega su artículo para la próxima edición del periódico, pero por órdenes "desde arriba", toda la tirada es retirada bajo la acusación de difamación. Mientras tanto, Dmitri no renuncia a su plan de separar a Piotr y Rita. Se reúne con el exnovio de su hija, Aleksandr, instructor del centro náutico, y le da su visto bueno para retomar la relación con Rita… siempre y cuando logre deshacerse de Piotr.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney, Baby Bop, and BJ are helping the kids get ready for a school play. Barney tells everyone that putting on shows began in Greece. Of course, the little dinos and kids want to visit the country, so off they go! While there, they meet some friends and decide to put on a play in an amphitheatre. Barney knows a great story that originated in Greece called King Midas. By the end of the day, everyone has learned that wanting too much is not a good thing, especially BJ!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Ben accidentally includes Kioko's prized music box from Switzerland in a cardboard box of yard sale items-the music box is sold! Kioko is sad and Ben wants to make things right, so he and Barney travel to Switzerland in search of a replacement gift. While there, they sample Swiss food, customs and games-but no music box! Luckily when Ben returns the music box is returned!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When the kids find a mysterious, colorful egg in the park, Barney takes them on a trip to Kenya to try to find out what kind of animal could have laid the egg. While in Kenya, Barney and the kids meet Ayira who introduces them to many people, cultures, and animals of the country!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: A Bird of a Different Feather
programme.desc: Ben and Rusty are looking for items for superhero costumes, when Barney comes to life, wearing a tutu. Tracy comes in and explains that she needs to find a bird of paradise for a school project. Ben, unsure, tells her they're only found in Hawaii and what they look like. Barney then takes the kids to Hawaii, using his Travel Book. In Hawaii, they learn different words, how to make leis and even a hula dance. Meanwhile, Ben and Rusty search for the bird, with a few close calls (a feather and what ended up being a coconut). During the Luau, it's revealed that the Bird of Paradise is actually a flower, not a bird. Ben, believing that it was a bird earlier, is shocked to hear that and apologizes to Rusty for getting him caught up in things. In the end, it all ends up just fine.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma wants to paint an award-winning painting for the Art In The Park Show, but she isn't satisfied with her artwork. Barney takes her to France to learn how to paint from his friend Pierre. While there, they learn about France. And Emma learns how to paint by following her heart!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: It's Earth Day, a great time for everyone to learn how to help take care of our world, but Ben is wasting paper while BJ isn't too concerned about cutting down a tree to make room for a new playground. After a trip to the rainforest and a meeting with Mother Nature, everyone learns the importance of taking care of our world. As Earth Day comes to an end, Barney reminds us all that taking good care of our Earth is the natural thing to dofor the people we love.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney helps Baby Bop see that winter can be a wonderful time for fun. Then, when she least expects itthe snow begins to fall! Barney and his friends are decorating the caboose for Christmas when Barney decides to plan a Secret Santa game. Everyone has to buy or make a gift for the friend whose name they have drawn.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff decides to create a musical zoo when their zoo trip is postponed. Gathering instruments that sound like real animals, Riff gives Barney and his friends a zoo-mazing experience. Baby Bop enjoys her homemade boat but wants to ride in a big one. Barney shows her boats on the computer, while BJ and Riff prepare a surprise. When they return, a sailing ship awaits Baby Bop on the playset!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop's friend Monty the butterfly passes through the park with a flock of friends on their way to Mexico. When Monty gets left behind, Barney takes everyone on a visit to Mexico to return Monty to his insect friends and family and give Baby Bop the chance to say goodbye to her butterfly friend.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney's excited to find out that Rusty's family is adopting a new baby sister from China; however, Rusty's not sure if he's going to be a good brother, and he doesn't know much about China. Barney shows Rusty and the others some info China on the computer and BJ and Baby Bop talk about siblings. Through Barney's Travel Book, Barney takes Rusty, BJ and Baby Bop on an adventure to China where he can learn more about his new sister's heritage. When they get there, the people are celebrating Chinese New Year. From lion dances and talented performers to tasty treats, making lanterns and puppet shows, the celebration never runs out of fun. By the time he returns to the park, Rusty excitedly meets his new baby sister, named Mei Ling, and realizes he will be the best big brother ever.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Ben is late to the park and is disappointed to realize he missed his chance at riding a real pony. He has waited his whole life for this, and now it looks as if hes missed his opportunity. Luckily, Barney takes Ben to Spain where they meet Regalo, a dancing horse with Riff and Baby Bop. Ben and Barney return to the park just in time for him to ride the pony after all! Ben is thrilled to ride a horse and learned an important lesson about patience and waiting.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma is stuck with a school project and can't play soccer with Joshua. Emma learns that if she makes the mask in parts, she'll get it done. Barney reminds her of this lesson, so she will do the same for her school project.

programme.title: Jaque Mate
programme.desc: David Hernández, conocido por ser el presentador del exitoso programa ficticio de juegos "Jaque Mate", se ve repentinamente sumergido en una pesadilla cuando recibe una llamada anónima durante una transmisión en vivo. El desconocido le informa que su hijo y esposa han sido secuestrados y que su vida depende de seguir las instrucciones que le dará en el programa. - Aterrorizado y bajo la presión del secuestrador, David se ve obligado a convertir su programa en un escenario para cumplir con las demandas del criminal. Mientras la audiencia mira atónita, David debe resolver acertijos y desafíos en tiempo real para garantizar la seguridad de su familia. La tensión aumenta a medida que cada movimiento en el juego televisivo podría significar la diferencia entre la vida y la muerte para sus seres queridos. Determinado y enfrentando peligros desconocidos, David se embarca en una incansable búsqueda para reunir a su familia sana y salva, desafiando todo lo que le rodea para lograr su objetivo.

programme.title: Te pido un taxi
programme.desc: Rodrigo, un joven seductor, asegura que el amor no existe y por eso disfruta de su solteria. Pero tras conocer a Sol, las reglas del juego cambian drasticamente.

programme.title: Memorias de lo que no fue
programme.desc: En el sórdido submundo de la vida nocturna de la Ciudad de México, Fernando y Miguel se conocen durante una noche salvaje en un famoso club gay. Lo que comienza como un encuentro casual se transforma en un misterio inquietante cuando Fernando despierta a la mañana siguiente sin recordar quién es ni cómo llegó allí. Sin ningún tipo de identificación y perdido en una niebla de confusión, se encuentra dependiendo de Miguel, quien promete ayudarle a descubrir su pasado olvidado. - Mientras navegan por los fragmentos poco fiables de los recuerdos de Fernando, los dos jóvenes se ven arrojados a una relación intensa e inesperada. Su búsqueda de la verdad se vuelve cada vez más peligrosa, revelando oscuros secretos y peligros ocultos que acechan en las sombras de sus pasados. La historia avanza con la aparición de nuevos personajes envueltos en misterio e intriga, empujando a Fernando y Miguel al borde de su cordura. Lo que comienza como una exploración de la amnesia y la identidad se convierte en un thriller impactante, donde la búsqueda de respuestas se encuentra con el derramamiento de sangre y la venganza.

programme.title: El Despertar el Polvo
programme.desc: Una película que reflexiona, sin emitir juicios, sobre el origen de la violencia y da voz a los verdaderos protagonistas de un mundo marcado por el crimen en las afueras de la Ciudad de México.

programme.desc: Una historia española sobre la mayoría de edad que se centra en las travesuras de dos jóvenes de 17 años, que tienen una lujosa casa en la playa casi para ellos solos un verano. Este es un verano de despertares sexuales.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Todd Rogers embraces the business of being a hunting outfitter as a labor of love. programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New Zealand’s Wild Flavors, Māori Culture & Volcanic Hot Spring Cooking"
programme.desc: They say you come to New Zealand as a stranger, but leave as family. In this episode of DIRT, the crew goes full circle—meeting Muttonbird chefs Emma and George on the South Island before hopping up to Raglan and working their way back down. Water skiing next to snow-capped mountains, cooking in hot springs the Māori way, and stargazing at Wairarapa Dark Sky Reserve are all on the itinerary. But it’s the final “Feed” done Kiwi-style that makes one thing clear—in this unique and stunning land, nobody’s a stranger for long.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 194
programme.desc: This episode features the sleek De Antonio D60, a 60-foot Spanish yacht renowned for its clean deck and hidden outboards, alongside a look at the innovative Euthalia lightning protection system. programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 195
programme.desc: This episode features the luxury and speed of the Celebration for the 40th anniversary of Pershing in Capri, alongside the superyacht prowess of Heesen Yachts' Agnetha, a 55-meter yacht with a 4,500 NM range. programme.desc: This segment showcases three impressive boats: the Ranieri International Cayman 50, a 50-foot luxury maxi-RIB capable of 55 knots; the Italian icon Riva 58 Capri, a new sport-open yacht blending high-speed performance and classic elegance; and the Bayliner V36 (PBIBS 2025), a versatile express cruiser known for maximizing family cruising space.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Celebrating Thanksgiving in France, where it's not a holiday, has its challenges. Host Sarah Sharratt pulls off a traditional Thanksgiving dinner with the help of her local butcher and family members visiting from the US. Wanting to add a French twist to her meal, Sarah collects fresh vegetables from a vibrant local market to make the famous dish 'ratatouille' to go along with a butternut squash soup, stuffed turkey and pumpkin pie.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt

The hunters inpire Sarah to throw a dinner party featuring stuffed pigeon on roasted fennel and pommes dauphinoise (potato gratin). For dessert Sarah makes an apple tresse with armagnac, another traditional ingredient she sources from a famous local producer.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story

The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: Stone Roses - Made Of Stone
programme.desc: In 2012, a resurrection no one thought possible took place when legendary band, The Stone Roses reformed after 16 years. With unprecedented access to previously unseen archive footage, MADE OF STONE is a revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Johnny Thunders - Madrid Memory
programme.desc: A long lost live concert performance from The Heartbreakers explosive 1984 reunion world tour that included fellow Dolls Sylvain Sylvain & Jerry Nolan plus Billy Rath! Filmed for TV broadcast at La Edad De Oro in Madrid, Spain, this concert captures powerful performances of songs from throughout Thunders's amazing career including Personality Crisis, Too Much Junkie Business, Born Too Lose
